TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit SKGraphiteBackendTexture extends SkiaSharp.SKObject

Docs.summary: Wraps an existing, caller-allocated GPU texture for use as a Graphite render target or image source.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
Create an instance from a native texture handle with a backend-specific factory such as <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteBackendTexture.CreateVulkan(System.Int32,System.Int32,SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteVkTextureInfo,System.Int32,System.UInt32,System.IntPtr)>, <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteBackendTexture.CreateMetal(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.IntPtr)>, or <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteBackendTexture.CreateDawn(System.IntPtr)>. This type wraps a native Skia resource and implements <xref:System.IDisposable>. The caller retains ownership of the underlying GPU texture; disposing this object does not free it.

Docs.summary: Gets the graphics backend of the wrapped texture.
Docs.value: One of the enumeration values that identifies the backend.
